signals.title: Podcast: The Future of Web Apps: Will AI Agents Generate UIs on the Fly?
signals.insight: As sovereign AI mandates expand, cloud-dependent architectures face exclusion from institutional and government procurement. 7-layer governance stack with Ed25519 signing addresses this with zero-network-egress deployment models that keep data and inference within sovereign boundaries.
